@{concat(if(contains(coalesce(outputs('Get_Message')?['body/mb_body'],''), '{{Signature}}'), replace(coalesce(outputs('Get_Message')?['body/mb_body'],''), '{{Signature}}', variables('vSignature')), concat(coalesce(outputs('Get_Message')?['body/mb_body'],''), if(empty(variables('vSignature')), '', concat('

parameters.fetchXml: <fetch><entity name="systemuser"><attribute name="fullname"/><attribute name="firstname"/><attribute name="lastname"/><attribute name="internalemailaddress"/><attribute name="jobtitle"/><filter><condition attribute="isdisabled" operator="eq" value="0"/></filter><link-entity name="teammembership" from="systemuserid" to="systemuserid" intersect="true"><filter><condition attribute="teamid" operator="eq" value="@{items('For_Each_Member')?['_mb_teamid_value']}"/></filter></link-entity></entity></fetch>
